headline: Bold Devanagari Hindi. White main text with exactly one keyword in red or yellow. Black/ExtraBold weight. Fills top 25-35% of the frame.
text_placement: Headline top-center or top-full-width. No text in bottom corners.
badge: '2D ANIMATION' in a yellow rounded rectangle with black bold text, bottom-center, on every thumbnail.
characters: 1-2 main illustrated figures, large, center/right. Intense, shocked, determined, or grave expression. Chest-up or full body.
background: Split composition: one side dark dramatic scene (red smoke, rain, night), other side context (parliament, map, building). High contrast.
color_contrast: Near-black / deep red / dark navy background against a brightly lit character, tuned to pop on YouTube's dark UI.
emotion_trigger: Dramatic weather, searchlights, classified documents, blood traces for tension - never gore.
title_formula: 'Kaise [Person] ne [dramatic event]' OR '[Operation Name]: [shocking reveal]' OR '[Person] ka [event] - [consequence]'. Max 10 Hindi words.
power_words_hint: use Hindi power words (kaise, kyun, asli, khufiya, saazish, raaz) for click-through
